cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(ChimeraQuantumCpp LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
add_library(chimera_quantum_cpp STATIC src/StateVector.cpp)
target_include_directories(chimera_quantum_cpp PUBLIC include)
add_executable(chimera_quantum_cpp_test tests/test_quantum.cpp)
target_link_libraries(chimera_quantum_cpp_test PRIVATE chimera_quantum_cpp)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME chimera_quantum_cpp COMMAND chimera_quantum_cpp_test)
